Your Security Platform for Peace of Mind 

The Huntress security platform is built, owned, and operated entirely by our team from first signal through remediation. Predictable pricing with no noise, just meaningful alerts. 

Managed EDR 

Huntress Managed EDR doesn't just watch your endpoints—it’s a complete solution. From the second a threat appears until it’s eliminated, we handle everything. You get 24/7 continuous protection, detection, and response that disrupts and remediates threats. 

Industry-leading MTTR 

4.5M Endpoints protected

Managed ITDR 

Identity Threat Detection and Response (ITDR) 
Finds and stops identity-based threats in Microsoft 365—because identity is the new endpoint, and attackers know it. Huntress Managed ITDR is designed to detect, respond to, and resolve critical identity-based threats like account takeovers, business email compromise, unauthorized logins, and more. 

Industry-leading 3min MTTR 

9M identities protected

Solutions Built for Real-World Threats 

Our team gets inside the mind of a hacker to anticipate their next move and shut them down before they can hurt your business. From enterprises to the MSPs supporting them, organizations of ALL sizes trust us to stay ahead of what's coming. 

BUSINESS EMAIL COMPROMISE 

51% of 
customers 

experience an attack 

With $6.3B+ stolen globally in 2024, email compromise is big business for shady hackers. Our defense-in-depth approach covers every angle: endpoint monitoring, identity protection, educating your end users, and email security that actually works. 
Learn more about BEC 

RANSOMWARE 

17-Hour 
Average 

time-to-ransom 

Every second counts when attackers move through your network. Ransomware isn't a single event; it's around 18 separate actions building toward disruption, and you have less than 1 business day to react. Huntress catches ransomware gangs and shuts them down before they wreak havoc on your business. 
Learn more about Ransomware 

ADVERSARY-IN-THE-MIDDLE 

50% 
increase 

YoY in AiTM attacks 

Adversary-in-the-Middle (AiTM) attacks jumped WAY up this year because hackers found a way to slip past MFAs. They intercept your authentication in real time, swiping session tokens when you think you're safe. Our identity-level visibility spots compromised sessions instantly and takes action before damage is done. 
Learn more about AiTM 

PHISHING 

31% of Security 
incidents 

Involve phishing 

Human risk management is a major concern for ALL businesses now, but your people can be your first layer of defense. Users actually enjoy our Managed Security Awareness Training—and we make administration a breeze. 
Learn more about Phishing 

ROGUE APPLICATIONS 

46% of 
security pros 

say rogue apps are a top identity threat 

Malicious OAuth apps are a go-to move for attackers to steal data and maintain persistence. Get a full view into every rogue app installed across tenants and proactively find Traitorware and Stealthware before they wreak havoc. 
Learn more about Rogue Applications 

COMPLIANCE 

58% of 
businesses 

aren’t ready for CMMC requirements 

Regulators, customers, and insurers demand proof of your security, which strains already stretched teams. Huntress makes compliance support accessible to ALL businesses, including those undergoing CMMC Level 2 audits. 
Learn more about Compliance 

Global Threats We've Wrecked 

The Huntress Adversary Tactics and SOC teams work together to protect your business by hunting, tracking, and analyzing novel threats around the world. Every novel attack they spot and piece of hacker tradecraft they decode gets documented and shared with the community.

Food Fight! 

A threat actor broke into a Wisconsin food factory’s network, and our SOC saw it all. See how we stopped the attack and got them back to business. 
Learn more about this attack 

Uninvited Guest 

An Arizona hotel chain was unknowingly hosting a squatter. Our SOC caught it, booted the intruder, and cleaned it up before damage happened. 
See examples of this attack 

Biting Back 

A professional dental organization was targeted in a massive brute-force campaign. Thankfully, Managed SIEM isn’t just for compliance—it turns threat intel into defense. 
See how SIEM helps with that 

Twisted Metal 
When a European metals manufacturer deployed the Huntress agent during an active intrusion, we learned that threat actors exploit blind spots, so deploying Managed EDR across all endpoints reduces exposure. 
Learn more about this attack 

Hungry Down Under 

An Australian food factory’s RDP was exposed to the public internet, and threat actors took advantage. The good news: Managed EDR helps wreck RDP server threats. 
See how Managed EDR helps 

This Isn't a Movie 

Our team dropped a full deep-dive on a state-sponsored intrusion targeting Web3, macOS users, and crypto foundations. Read how TA444 (BlueNoroff) pulled it off—and Huntress EDR caught it. 
Read the full story

A threat actor got into a medical facility’s network and gave it a full work-up. Our 24/7 human-led, AI-assisted SOC isolated the network—no need to intubate.
